mf_reader_check.note: descriptive MODEL_FIT out-of-fold readers; never a decision input

ALT.operation: NEURAL_RAW's own recipe continued beyond E2 (RAW_J, rho 1), grid E3..E10

CTRL.operation: SEX-blind subtractive-dithered quantization of NEURAL_RAW (sar.ctlkit.dq_fit / dq_release, DQ_GRID_FINE, tag SAR_DQ_FB_S0); basis on the cross-fitted RAWJ-E2 outputs

recipe.objective: sum_v [Phi(D_v / sqrt 2) - 1/2], v in (income, occupation, pair); D_v^2 = Delta_v^T (S_v + eps_v I)^-1 Delta_v on degree-2 polynomial features of the standardized logit differences; pooled within-SEX covariance
recipe.start: deployed fit: U0_S<v> (acs_replication STAGE_A_<v>/U0_MODEL.pt); fold k: the U0 recipe (Recipe A refit from scratch, admitted epoch count and seed, Adam 1e-3, batch 512) on the fold training rows
recipe.task_rows: NEURAL_RAW task stream (seed_for("THP1task", seed)); privacy rows: random.Random(seed_for("SAR1pfd-privacy", seed))

selection.dq_basis_fitted_on: cross-fitted RAWJ E2 MODEL_FIT outputs (SEX never read)
selection.rule: k* = the largest checkpoint E_k (k = 1..10) such that E_1..E_k all keep estimate + 2 household-clustered SE <= BUDGET on every component of the MODEL_FIT out-of-fold paired spend over the fold start (folds SAR_xf_FB_S<v>)
